svg.title: Mini MoonBoard V5 three-string wiring topology, rear view
svg.desc: Rear view starts at A1 lower right, climbs A, alternates columns to K12 upper left. Controller LED1 feeds A1. PWR1 supplies boost at I4, end of second string. External leads are schematic, not measured routes.
svg.text: REAR VIEW: A at right; climbing-face view has A at left. TOP ↑
Solid lines: 131 inter-LED connections, schematic spacing. Dashed: external leads/tail; physical routes and lengths unverified.
132 installed positions. 150 − 132 = 18 unused by arithmetic; guide states 16 spares. Confirm actual kit. No wiring modification prescribed.
